caption: A packet reaches the home address, is wrapped in an outer header and tunnelled to the foreign agent, which unwraps it and delivers it. The dashed direct route is the shortcut that route optimisation uses.

spec.title: Mobile IP: packet path through the home agent
spec.aria: A packet from the correspondent goes to the home agent, is tunnelled to the foreign agent, and reaches the mobile node, with a dashed direct route also shown.
